purpose: One bounded follow-up to distinguish Wikinews coverage failure from E13 frequency-design failure while preserving the original thresholds.

premise.decision: A broader corpus is warranted because tokenizer geometry is not the limiting mechanism.

source_selection.rationale: Keep the already sufficient Latin source fixed and replace only the underpowered Chinese-news coverage with a much broader first-party Chinese Wikipedia article range. The Chinese text contribution is bounded before inspection to control tokenizer memory.
source_selection.license_note: Most Wikimedia text is CC BY-SA 4.0 and GFDL; the derived corpus is internal evidence and is not committed or redistributed. Source projects, dump URLs, dates, and transformation remain recorded for attribution.

transform.selection: namespace 0, non-redirect pages with non-empty current revision text; stop a source before the first page that would exceed its predeclared emitted-byte cap
transform.emission: UTF-8 title, LF, exact XML-decoded revision text, LF, in source dump order
transform.normalization: XML entity resolution and XML line-ending normalization performed by Python stdlib ElementTree only; no markup stripping, sampling, deduplication, Unicode normalization, or language cleanup

e13_design_frozen_unchanged.failure_policy: If any cell still has fewer than 512 eligible rows, seal the refusal and revisit the factorial design. Do not tune thresholds or acquire a third corpus merely to force occupancy.

claim_boundary: This freezes the sole broader-corpus retry before corpus-derived occupancy is inspected. It does not establish corpus sufficiency, authorize row extraction, execute E13, establish a representation, construct a complete NR, measure EBPW/TPS/capability, promote Pulsar, deploy Hawking, or retire Kimi.
